nodes.title: Note: size
widgets_values:
MiniMax H3 Image doesn't work well in low resolution

This workflow starts at a reduced default resolution(4MP). Raise the size if your GPU has enough memory.


## Recommended sizes (16MP)

The effective working range of MiniMax-H3-Image is about 4 MP to 20 MP, and it generally gives
the best results at around 16 MP. Common 16 MP sizes are listed below:

| Aspect ratio | Size (width x height) |
| --- | --- |
| 1:1 | 4096x4096 |
| 4:3 / 3:4 | 4736x3552 / 3552x4736 |
| 3:2 / 2:3 | 5024x3360 / 3360x5024 |
| 16:9 / 9:16 | 5472x3072 / 3072x5472 |
| 21:9 | 6272x2688 |

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: A beautiful, naturalistic photograph of a futuristic city seen from street level at golden hour, framed as a wide 16:9 view along a broad pedestrian avenue. The camera stands at eye level near the center of the street, looking straight down the avenue so the towers rise steeply on both sides and converge toward a distant skyline. Slender terraced towers with rounded corners, pale metal and warm glass facades, rooftop gardens, and slender skybridges frame the view above. An elevated transit line crosses between buildings farther down the avenue, and a sleek tram moves along a planted median in the middle distance, with a few pedestrians on the sidewalks and a small autonomous shuttle near the curb for scale. The low sun enters from the left, casting long shadows across the pavement and lighting the street in amber, honey, and soft rose tones; glass facades catch bright highlights while shaded storefronts stay muted and cool. Between the towers in the upper-right sky, a large ringed planet is clearly visible, its thin luminous rings tilted gently across its face. The sky transitions from warm gold near the horizon to deepening blue overhead. Realistic photographic detail, believable materials, crisp architectural edges, visible street texture, gentle atmospheric haze in the distance, and no lettering, signage, or watermarks.
